channel.description: Latest articles from Ink Free News (inkfreenews.com)

item.title: Pizza Hut To Close 250 Locations Nationwide
item.description: Pizza Hut plans to close 250 underperforming U.S. locations during the first half of 2026 as parent company Yum! Brands continues a broader strategic review of the chain’s future.

item.title: House Panel Weighs Tighter School Cellphone Ban, Districts Seek Flexibility
item.description: A stricter, “bell-to-bell” ban on student cellphone use was the subject of extended debate Wednesday, Feb. 4 as Indiana lawmakers wrestled with lingering concerns over how schools would store devices - and how much that could cost - under pending legislation.

item.title: Syracuse Public Library – A Lot To Love At SPL
item.description: Library Lover’s Month occurs each February and makes for the perfect opportunity to get lost in a new book and hang out at the Syracuse Public Library.

item.title: Smaller Airports Around Indiana Struggle To Keep Up With Needs
item.description: General aviation - the term for non-commercial flying that includes everything from corporate jets to small aircraft enthusiasts – pumped $339 billion into the national economy in 2023, including $7.7 billion for Indiana, according to a study by the General Aviation Manufacturers Association.

item.title: Analysis Finds Expanding Hoosier Forest Could Net $235M Yearly Benefits
item.description: Lawmakers and conservation groups are renewing a push in early 2026 to expand Indiana’s only federally designated wilderness area and create a new national recreation area within the Hoosier National Forest.

item.title: On the road to Hana
item.description: Just as the queasiness in my stomach from the continuous onslaught of curves and cutbacks along the narrow uphill road began to subside, we careened around another 180-degree hairpin bend.

item.title: ‘Hailey’s Law’: Family Pushing For Changes As They Grieve Fishers Teen Hailey Buzbee
item.description: The Family of a missing Fishers teenager who is believed to have been found dead is pushing for changes to protect children.

item.title: Controversial Data Center Provision Will Not Advance After Backlash
item.description: A controversial provision that would have allowed data centers and other developments to be built on unproductive agricultural land without public input will not advance after its passage in the House sparked backlash.

item.title: Insurance says I owe nothing, so why is Quest Diagnostics demanding $563?
item.description: Jan Burnett thinks her routine blood tests are behind her when she receives an explanation of benefits showing zero patient responsibility.

item.title: Indiana To Partner With Charlie Kirk’s Turning Point USA To Expand Presence In Schools
item.description: Indiana Republican leaders are working to mint a partnership with late conservative activist Charlie Kirk's youth organization, Turning Point USA, that would strive to start chapters in every school and punish those who block their creation.
